# Synthetic failure capture after the opt-in two_stage_v3 layout

Source commit 3c8046a7f554b669770724b6c9b143ace84709d5 (explicit two_stage_v3: one closed action question, one target question conditioned on the chosen action, then detail; revisit x multiple handled like the other ambiguous actions; independent S4 verification of both). Two independent captures were made on a clean tree with the generator (`node tests/support/generate-failure-fixture.ts <dir>`); they differ from each other only at 15 run-ID leaves.

Compared with the replaced failure-path-two-stage-v2-606efdf capture (which was never adopted outside this branch and is removed), records differ only at 31 leaves: 15 run IDs, 15 instruction-source hash leaves (`decision/jev-decision.ts`, `v2/jev-turn.ts` and `v2/dialogue-v2.mjs` in each of the 5 scenarios) and the derived `identity.prompts` digest. Every request payload, behavior, schema, failure, clock, policy, call/send and storage is unchanged. The generator writes a stale baseCommit literal; it was set by hand to the source commit above. Earlier adopted fixture directories (including failure-path-repair-facts-e6e2c67) remain byte-identical. No real API, Keychain, .env, study data or live run was used.
